scenes.vo: GTA 6 made three point seven nine billion dollars on day one. In a single day.
Take-Two says that's the biggest entertainment launch in history, across any medium. It's a company estimate, up to the end of November nineteenth.
scenes.cap: Take-Two: biggest entertainment launch ever (company estimate)

scenes.vo: Before launch, it had already sold thirty two point five million copies. A record across all platforms.
Now compare GTA 5. Analyst Daniel Ahmad says it made about eight hundred million dollars on its first day.
scenes.cap: GTA 5 day one: about $800 million (analyst Daniel Ahmad)

scenes.vo: So GTA 6's first day is roughly four point seven times bigger.
Critics agree too. A Metascore of ninety nine from the first hundred and sixty four reviews, tying Ocarina of Time for the highest ever.
scenes.cap: Metascore 99 from 164 reviews: ties the all-time record

scenes.vo: GTA 5 alone has sold nearly two hundred thirty five million copies. Can GTA 6 beat that?
scenes.cap: GTA 5: nearly 235 million units. Can GTA 6 beat it?
